git rm -q app/backend/.env.example && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='.env.example'
s=open(p).read()
old='NEBIUS_OUTPUT_VOLUME=\n'
new=('# Optional: the bucket\'s RESOURCE ID (storagebucket-...) to mount at /outputs for\n'
     '# checkpoints. The API rejects both the bucket name and an s3:// URI with\n'
     '# `invalid volume source`. Get it from `nebius storage bucket list`.\n'
     'NEBIUS_OUTPUT_VOLUME=\n')
assert s.count(old)==1
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
EOF
git add .env.example && git commit -q -m "Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/feat/db-route-multiscale'

Keep the single root env example and carry over the branch's note that
NEBIUS_OUTPUT_VOLUME must be the bucket resource ID." && git stash pop 2>&1 | tail -2; echo "--- log ---"; git log --oneline -3; echo "--- tracked changes ---"; git status --short | grep -vE '^\?\?'; echo "--- ahead of origin/main: $(git rev-list --count origin/main..main)"
